1479-4677-5700-5701-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4677-5700-5701-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

728-1856-6249--5.easyPrerequisites: Doom Weaver paired with the persist creature.
728-1856-6249--5.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Doom Weaver trigger.
Resolve the Doom Weaver trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Doom Weaver and Olivia trigger.
Resolve the Doom Weaver ability, pairing it with the persist creature.
Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from the persist creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

777-1170-5131-6797--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
777-1170-5131-6797--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Foundry Inspector.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

1887-3099-4762-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
1887-3099-4762-7803.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Brad Boimler and Vorinclex.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2511-6872-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
2511-6872-7690--165.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

876-7070-7444.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Advanced Reconstruction.
Repeat.

2440-6633-7082-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka's first ability and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, attaching Trusty Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4195-4211-4311-4574.description:
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Tormod's Crypt from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3293-5412-5721-6763.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
3293-5412-5721-6763.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
3293-5412-5721-6763.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

3609-4331-6788.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus {2} in two different colors each turn
3609-4331-6788.description:
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding one mana of any color and causing the next artifact spell you cast to have sunburst.
Cast Magistrate's Scepter by paying {3} using three different colors of mana.
Magistrate's Scepter's sunburst ability triggers, causing it to enter with three charge counters on it.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Drafna by paying {1}{U}, returning Magistrate's Scepter from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
3609-4331-6788.notes: When adding mana in step 1, you should ensure that whatever color of mana you add will allow you to pay three different colors of mana while casting Magistrate's Scepter. If you already have three different colors of mana available, you can add {U} to pay for Drafna instead.

460-539-5711.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
460-539-5711.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Fanatic of Rhonas.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

215-1418-6470.description:
Cast Iridescent Tiger by paying {4}{R}.
When Iridescent Tiger enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Iridescent Tiger from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2092-3719-5241-5326.notablePrerequisites: Sakashima's Student and Agatha of the Vile Cauldron each have a power of at least 2.
2092-3719-5241-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Sakashima's Student and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Sakashima's Student from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Sakashima's Student to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Sakashima's Student enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Sakashima's Student by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-3661-5220-5683.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Shield Sphere and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

38-1270-2316.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
38-1270-2316.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating nine 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Skirk Prospector three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

1863-3946-5448.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

3199-3209-4146.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
You control at least two untapped creatures, one of which must be green.
3199-3209-4146.description:
Activate Spellbinding Soprano's encore ability by paying {3}{R} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Declare each Spellbinding Soprano token as an attacker.
Each Spellbinding Soprano token triggers, causing instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn to cost {1} less to cast for each Spellbinding Soprano token.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by tapping a green creature and any other creature you control.
Murmuring Mystic's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Bird Illusion creature token.
Resolve Sprout Swarm, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

49-1216-1799-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sengir Autocrat, adding {1}.
When Sengir Autocrat leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, exiling all Serf tokens.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Sengir Autocrat on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Sengir Autocrat into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sengir Autocrat enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating three 0/1 Serf creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing the Serfs, adding {3}.
Repeat.

2068-4283-5295.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
2068-4283-5295.description:
Activate Whisper by tapping and sacrificing it and another nontoken creature you control, targeting any applicable creature card in your graveyard.
Ashnod triggers, copying Whisper's ability, targeting Whisper.
Resolve both Whisper abilities, returning Whisper and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

328-387-2034-2693-4871.notablePrerequisites: Gray Merchant in hand.You control less than two Thrulls.
328-387-2034-2693-4871.description:
Cast Gray Merchant by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Endrek Sahr triggers, creating five 1/1 Thrull creature tokens.
Gray Merchant enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose at least four life and you to gain life equal to the life you gained this way.
Activate Ashnod's Altar six times by sacrificing Gray Merchant and five Thrulls, adding twelve {C}.
The Thrulls and Grey Merchant die, triggering Pitiless Plunderer six times, creating six Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Reclamation by paying {1}{B} and two life, returning Gray Merchant from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

201-3218.description:
Shifting Sky causes all creatures to be black.
Because Light of Day prevents black creatures from attacking or blocking, no creature can attack or block.

141-500.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
141-500.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Saw in Half
141-500.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Saw in Half, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Saw in Half, destroying Naru Meha and creating two token copies of it with half its toughness and power, rounded up each time.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.

1434-4364-4702.description:
During your combat phase, activate the nontoken Aurelia by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
Declare the token Aurelia as an attacker.
The token Aurelia triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

312-719-2034-5189.notablePrerequisites:
A creature you control has a +1/+1 counter on it.
"Zombie" chosen with Xenograft.
312-719-2034-5189.description:
Activate Ghave by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control to create a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Champion of the Perished triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1409-2608-5116.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Derevi.
1409-2608-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Derevi enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator.
Resolve the Derevi trigger, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing Derevi with Deadeye Navigator.
Repeat.

4148-4398.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
4148-4398.notablePrerequisites: You have an additional instant or sorcery card in hand.
4148-4398.description:
Cast the additional instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost, triggering Eye of the Storm.
Holding priority, cast Spellshift by paying {3}{U} targeting the instant or sorcery spell.
Eye of the Storm triggers, exiling Spellshift and casting copies of Spellshift and any other instants and/or sorceries exiled by Eye of the Storm of your choosing without paying their mana costs.
Choose to have Spellshift target any instant or sorcery spell on the stack of your choosing.
Resolve Spellshift, countering the chosen instant or sorcery spell and then revealing an instant or sorcery card from your library, cast it without paying its mana cost, and shuffle your library.
Eye of the Storm triggers, exiling the instant or sorcery and casting copies of Spellshift and any other instants and/or sorceries exiled by Eye of the Storm of your choosing without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from step 4.
